rows.name: Bybit
farm_steps: Set up a fresh wallet for Bybit and fund it on Bitcoin; keep the seed phrase offline and only farm funds in it. Cost: about $3 of gas to start. Time: 10 minutes.
Open an account at Bybit, deposit $250 and run small spot trades each week so the account shows real activity. Cost: $250 of capital plus about $15 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Repeat one real action every week — a deposit, a borrow, a swap, a bridge or a vote — so the wallet reads as a user, not a snapshot. Cost: about $90 a month in gas and fees. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position at least 30 days, across more than one activity snapshot, and check Bybit's own points or rewards page weekly, claiming only from links it publishes. Cost: the $250 stays in the position. Time: 30 days.

If Bybit launches and allocates 5% of its $239,357,585 implied value to early users (an assumption, not a promise), the early-user pool is about $11,967,879; this plan costs about $90 over 1 month plus the $250 position. Verdict: thin. Cost: about $90 all-in. Time: 10 minutes to log the position and set a monthly review.
